title: Stacking Election Forecasts
abstract: We combine election forecasts with stacking weights from leave-future-out performance (Bayesian model averaging). Applications to U.S. presidential elections and German federal elections show stacked ensembles beat single-model benchmarks on accuracy and robustness.
